title: International Foundation Diploma In People and Organization Level 3
description: Enhance your understanding of human resources and organizational dynamics with the International Foundation Diploma in People and Organization (Level 3).
university: The Global School of Skills (GSS) and OTHM UK
longDescription: This course covers organizational structures, culture, and values, along with principles of planning and human resource management. Students will develop skills in teamwork, leadership, and personal and professional development.These skills will prepare students to effectively lead and manage teams in diverse settings. After the successful completion of the Programme, you will earn a UK 60 credit hours Certification awarded by GSS partners.
courseDetails: The International Foundation Diploma in People and Organization (Level 3) covers essential subjects such as organizational structures, culture, and values, along with principles of organizational planning and managing human resources. Students will explore personal and professional development, teamwork, and leadership and management skills. Emphasis is placed on applying organizational theories through case studies and projects, preparing graduates for diverse career opportunities or further studies in people and organizational management.
courseDetailParagraphs: The International Foundation Diploma in People and Organization (Level 3) covers essential subjects such as organizational structures, culture, and values, along with principles of organizational planning and managing human resources. Students will explore personal and professional development, teamwork, and leadership and management skills. Emphasis is placed on applying organizational theories through case studies and projects, preparing graduates for diverse career opportunities or further studies in people and organizational management.
entry: For entry into the International Foundation Diploma In People and Organization (Level-3), learners must possess:
* Relevant/Local Board of Examination Result in your Country, which must include at least 5 'C' Grades in English and 4 other subjects.
* Mock Examination Results can also be accepted for initial Conditional Admission, pending the release of the Board of Examination Results. (This is assessed on a case-by-case basis).
* Learner must be 18 years and older at the start of the Course.
Mature Learners (21 years and older) with work experience in supervisory, leadership or management roles. (This is assessed on a case-by-case basis).
accreditation: All GSS courses are accredited by the relevant partners and awarding bodies. Please refer to GSS accreditation in about us for more details.
progression: Upon completing the International Foundation Diploma In People and Organization (Level-3) students become eligible to pursue advanced studies, including admission into a Bachelor's degree. This qualification opens doors to various programs, allowing students to specialize further in areas such as human resource management, organizational development, or leadership.
workshops: This is a self-study programme with unlimited tutor support. You will never be more than a message or phone call away from our tutors. Workshops are conducted by live webinars for online students. Classroom workshops are available if there is a local branch in your country. Speak to our course advisors on this subject.
visa: There is no Visa requirement for this programme.
gettingStartedIntro: Complete the application, document review, offer, payment and enrolment steps through the learner portal.
certificateDetails: You will receive a degree from GSS Partner Universities.
Complete several modules ranging from Business Leadership and Managing People.

modules.title: Level 3-Leadership And Management Skills
modules.summary: This module introduces the foundational principles of leadership and management, focusing on building essential skills for effective team guidance and organizational success. Students will explore leadership styles, decision-making processes, goal-setting strategies, and ways to inspire and manage teams in diverse settings. Emphasis is placed on developing communication, problem-solving, and motivational skills to excel in leadership roles. By the end of the module, students will be equipped to lead confidently and adapt to various professional challenges.

lessons.title: Unit 1 Understanding Leadership and Management Principles
Unit 2 Leadership Styles and Decision-Making Techniques
Unit 3 Effective Goal-Setting and Team Management
Unit 4 Building Communication and Motivational Skills
Unit 1 Introduction to Human Resource Management
Unit 2 Recruitment and Selection Processes
Unit 3 Employee Development and Training
Unit 4 Performance Management and Appraisal

modules.title: Level 3-Organisation Structures And Their Culture And Values
modules.summary: This module provides an understanding of how organizational structures influence culture and values within a business environment. Students will explore different types of organizational structures, analyze their impact on workplace dynamics, and examine how culture and values shape employee behavior and overall performance. The module fosters critical thinking and prepares learners to contribute effectively to organizational success.

lessons.title: Unit 1 Introduction to Organizational Structures
Unit 2 The Role of Culture in Organizations
Unit 3 Values and Their Impact on Workplace Behavior
Unit 4 Aligning Structure, Culture, and Values for Success

modules.title: Level 3-Principles Of Organisational Planning
modules.summary: This module introduces students to the essential principles of organizational planning, focusing on the strategies, processes, and tools necessary to manage resources effectively within an organization. Students will explore the relationship between organizational goals, operational efficiency, and long-term success. The module emphasizes the importance of strategic planning, goal-setting, and resource allocation in achieving organizational objectives.

lessons.title: Unit 1 Understanding Organizational Planning and Strategy
Unit 2 Setting Organizational Goals and Objectives
Unit 3 Resource Allocation and Management
Unit 4 Developing and Implementing Strategic Plans

modules.title: Level 3-Personal And Professional Development
modules.summary: This module focuses on self-improvement and skill-building to excel in your career.

lessons.title: Unit 1 Self-Awareness and Personal Reflection
Unit 2 Setting Personal and Professional Goals
Unit 3 Developing Key Skills for Career Success
Unit 4 Time Management and Productivity Techniques
Unit 5 Networking and Building Professional Relationships

modules.title: Level 3-Teamwork
modules.summary: The Teamwork module equips students with the knowledge and skills to collaborate effectively in diverse team environments. Students will explore team dynamics, roles, and conflict resolution strategies to enhance productivity and harmony. The module emphasizes communication, leadership, and problem-solving within teams. By the end of the course, students will understand how to contribute positively to team goals and foster a collaborative workplace culture.

lessons.title: Unit 1 Understanding Team Dynamics
Unit 2 Roles and Responsibilities within a Team
Unit 3 Effective Communication in Teams
Unit 4 Leadership and Team Motivation and Conflict Resolution in Team Settings
